title: Complex Analysis (Differentiation & Integration)
description:
📌 Complex Analysis – Differentiation & Integration | Complete Course by Dr. Gajendra Purohit
Learn Complex Analysis, one of the most important topics in higher mathematics, with this comprehensive playlist by GP Sir. This course focuses on Differentiation and Integration of Complex Functions with detailed explanations and solved problems, essential for CSIR-NET, GATE, IIT JAM, UPSC Mathematics Optional, and B.Sc./M.Sc. Mathematics courses.

✅ Topics Covered:
       i)Analytical function and cauchy riemann equation 
      ii)Short trick to find harmonic conjugate.
      iii)Milne thomson method.
      iv)Bilinear transformation, conformal mapping. 
       v)Complex and line integration.
       vi)Cauchy integral formula for analytic function.
     vii)Cauchy residue theorem.
     viii)Contour integration,  application of residue theorem. 
      ix)Contour integration, evaluation of improper integrals
       x)Taylor series for complex variable.
       xi)Laurent series for complex number.

🔥 Learn with Dr. Gajendra Purohit and master Complex Analysis step by step with clarity and depth!

👉 Subscribe now for advanced mathematics tutorials and competitive exam preparation.
